about: Yasmine S. Mehmet is a top-rated attorney who practices law in San Francisco, California. Yasmine Mehmet focuses on Family Law issues. Additionally, she also helps clients with legal issues in the following areas of law: General Litigation.

Yasmine Mehmet received Super Lawyers designation for 2010 - 2026. She was selected for this honor subsequent to undergoing an evaluation of many different factors including peer recognition and professional achievement.
She became a licensed attorney in 1992. Before practicing law, she attended law school at University of British Columbia and graduated in 1990.
